svg.text: Caraiani–Newton: the roadmaps it needs, in upstream order

Tier 1 (closest to Mathlib and Tau Ceti) at the bottom; each box depends only on boxes in lower tiers. A box with several roadmaps is a bundle: each keeps its own package, and they go to Tau Ceti together in one pull request.

Lines show essential dependencies only (transitive reduction). Upward stage links and plan citations are not drawn: they move down. FoundationsAndLibraryIntegration (library bookkeeping) and the five roadmaps needed only through an upward citation (drops.json) are omitted.
current `top` label (tiers 1–4): being worked on now
final check on a Tau Ceti lane
pull request open, reviewer recommends approval
approval recommended at an earlier head
Badge "PR A/B": the roadmaps sharing a letter go up in one pull request (A = RG II + adelic groups + smooth representations; A′ stacked on A; B = the adic package). Updated 2026-10-14T20:24Z.
